title: 第10章  迷之自信
content_zh:
“木爷爷居然这么强！”
楚盈盈目瞪口呆，木老守护藏书阁十五年。从未展露过实力，谁都没想到，木老如此厉害，他的修为，居然仅次于楚山。
“居然是凡人境八层的修为了，怪不得能挡下我的光明拳！”
楚寻意脸色难看，他的光明拳，只是入门，并未小成，最多和木老打成平手。
但，要让他就这样退去。
他不甘心！
如果不能替子报仇，他还当什么父亲。
“光明拳！”
一声低吼，楚寻意再次打出了光明拳。
木老摇了摇头道：“没用，除非你光明拳小成，才有击败我的可能！”
“那我现在，就将它小成！”
楚寻意疯了！
他灵气疯狂运转，这样做，有灵气破体的可能。
但他非但没有破体，这些灵气还按照一定的路线，聚集到了右拳。
灵气流动间，手背上似乎形成了特殊的纹路。
他右拳的光芒，更加强盛。
这一拳的气势，突然暴涨！
“嗯？”
木老眼神一眯，这气势，忽然变强了。
这一拳的力量，让他察觉到了压力！

他惊讶地道：“光明拳小成！”
对面，楚寻意笑了，他近乎疯狂地道。
“这么多年，光明拳一直未有寸进，却没想到，在仇恨和杀意的刺激下，真的小成了！看来是老天爷也要让我替南儿报仇雪恨。木老，让开，否则，死！”
木老依旧没有让开，他举起拳头，也打出了一记光明拳。
但这一拳的威力，明显没有楚寻意强。
两拳相碰，哪怕木老的修为高于楚寻意一层，巨大的反震力，也让他后退了整整五步，脸色更是一阵潮红。
反观楚寻意，身如磐石，一步未退。
这就是武技入门同小成之间的巨大差距。
“哈哈，凡人境八层又如何，武技小成，你根本不是我的对手。木老，还是那句话，让开，不然死。今天，就算天王老子来了，也阻止不了我！这小杂种，我杀定了！”
楚寻意眼里的杀意，越来越强烈，佛挡杀佛，神挡杀神！
“完了……四伯父怎么这个时候武技小成了啊……七哥……”
一旁，楚盈盈急得都快哭了。
就在她手足无措的时候，一声怒吼从院子门口传来。
“天王老子也挡不了你？那我呢！”
声音落，楚山快步走了进来。
只是一两步，就出现在了楚弛的身前。
“爷爷，太好了，你回来了！”
一旁，楚盈盈松了口气。
楚山在楚家的地位，绝对没人敢忤逆。
果然，楚寻意的拳头，逐渐放了下来。

楚山脸色这才缓和了一点，他冷声质问道：“说说吧，为什么要找楚弛的麻烦？我临走之前是不是特意交代过，楚弛和楚南的恩怨，到此为止了。”
楚寻意指着楚南的尸体，声音颤抖地道：“爹，楚南死了！他不堪楚弛的羞辱，悬梁而去！”
楚山瞳孔一缩，这才看见花坛旁边，楚南的尸体。
身体僵硬，早已没了气息。
这小子，自杀了？
草蛋，真是个废渣！
这点打击就自杀。
“爹，你知道我的性格，我就这么一个儿子！楚弛害死了他，我要他拿命来还！爹，你可以护住他这一时，但你能十二个时辰都寸步不离地守住他吗？无论如何，我要这小杂种死！”
闻言，楚山没有说话。
如果楚寻意铁了心要杀楚弛，他还真不可能二十四小时守护楚弛。
就在他不知道说什么的时候，楚弛忽然开口了。
“楚寻意，你他妈的够了，楚南死了，同我有直接关系吗？又不是我杀的他。是他自己心智脆弱，受不了打击，这就是从小娇生惯养的结果！
他不是一直骂我废物吗，但我看，他才是废物。他活这么大，不过是温室中的花朵罢了，根本经不起一点风吹雨打。他死了，活该！”
楚弛的话，震惊了所有人。
谁都没想到，这种时候了，他还敢同楚寻意对着干。
此刻，楚寻意气的脑袋都快冒烟了！
“哇呀呀呀呀，小杂种，不弄死你，我就不是楚寻意！”
楚弛面不改色地道：“我知道你想杀我，但你这样杀我，会让人笑话的。这样吧，我给你一个光明正大的机会，我向你约战！十天后，在主院同你进行生死战。你敢应战吗？”
楚弛这话落，全场震惊。
无论是楚山，楚盈盈，或者是楚寻意本人，都是一脸懵逼，不敢相信自己的耳朵。

楚弛，居然主动同楚寻意约战！
一个晚辈，居然约战长辈。
而且，还是进行生死战。
天啊，这太疯狂了吧！
楚弛要是能击败楚寻意，那蟑螂就要称霸世界了！
“你说什么，你要同我约战？但你少来这一套！你怕是想趁这个时间，逃离飞云村吧！”
楚寻意冷冷开口，根本就不信楚弛真的会同他战斗。
这小杂种肯定会利用这个时间差，远走高飞。
“逃？你瞧不起谁呢。”
楚弛伸出手，指向了主院。
主院的屋顶，插着一面绣着楚字的族旗。
“我对着族旗，以天道发誓，要是逃跑，天打雷劈，不得好死。”
“楚寻意，我就问你，敢不敢迎战！你是不是怕十天后，败给我，被族人笑掉大牙！”
“我会败给你，你说什么梦话呢！好，就再给你十天时间活命，好好珍惜这最后的时光吧。”
“这么说，你答应了？”
“不错，答应了。你自己寻死，我当然成全你。”
楚寻意的话落，压制住心中的杀意，抱起楚南的尸体，一步步离去。
当楚寻意离开后，楚山这才看向楚弛，开口道：“亏你能想出这样的办法。趁老四还没有反应过来，赶紧走吧。”
楚弛眉头一皱，反问道：“爷爷，你莫非以为我刚才说的话，发的誓，只是权宜之计，你也认为我要逃跑？”
“那不然呢？你不过凡人境三层的修为，别说给你十天时间，就算给你十个月，甚至十年，你也不一定是老四的对手！”

这话落，楚盈盈非常认可，她一脸担忧地道：“七哥，还是赶紧跑吧！别管什么誓言，违背誓言，总比真丢了小命的好。活着，才是最重要的。快走吧。”
楚弛却是摇了摇头，眼神坚定地道：“你们，太看低我了。我不会走，十天后，我会当着你们的面，将楚寻意踩在脚下。”
楚盈盈一脸惊愕：“七哥，你来真的？但没听过有晚辈是长辈的对手啊。”
楚弛声音铿锵地道：“十天后，你就听过了。”
这话出，楚山眼神一眯，这小子似乎对自己迷之自信啊。
content_en:
"Grandpa Mu is actually so strong!"
Chu Yingying was stunned. Mu Lao had been guarding the library for fifteen years. He had never shown his strength before, and no one expected that Mu Lao was so powerful, and that his cultivation was second only to Chu Shan.
"He is actually at the eighth level of the mortal realm. No wonder he can block my bright fist!"
Chu Xunyi's face was ugly. His Guangming Fist was just a beginner, not a complete success. At most, he was tied with Mu Lao.
But let him retreat like this.
He is not willing to give in!
If he couldn't avenge his son, what kind of father would he be?
"Bright Fist!"
With a low roar, Chu Xunyi punched the Bright Fist again.
Mu Lao shook his head and said: "It's useless. Unless you become a master of Guangming Fist, you can defeat me!"
"Then I will complete it now!"
Chu Xunyi is crazy!
His spiritual energy is running wildly, and if he does this, there is a possibility that his spiritual energy will break his body.
But not only was his body not broken, the spiritual energy also gathered in his right fist according to a certain route.
As the spiritual energy flows, special lines seem to form on the back of the hand.
The light from his right fist became even stronger.
The momentum of this punch suddenly surged!
"Huh?"
Mu Lao narrowed his eyes, and his momentum suddenly became stronger.
The power of this punch made him feel the pressure!
He said in surprise: "The Light Fist is a small success!"
Opposite him, Chu Xunyi smiled, almost crazy.
"For so many years, Guangming Fist has not made any progress, but I didn't expect that, stimulated by hatred and murderous intent, it really became a success! It seems that God wants me to avenge Nan'er. Mu Lao, get out of the way, otherwise, I will die!"
Mu Lao still didn't give way. He raised his fist and also punched a bright punch.
But the power of this punch was obviously not as strong as Chu Xunyi's.
When the two fists collided, even though Mu Lao's cultivation level was higher than Chu Xunyi's level, the huge repulsive force made him take a full five steps back, and his face turned red.
On the other hand, Chu Xunyi's body was like a rock and he did not retreat even one step.
This is the huge gap between beginners and beginners in martial arts.
"Haha, so what if you are on the eighth level of the mortal realm? You are a minor martial artist. You are no match for me. Mu Lao, as I said before, get out of the way or die. Today, even if the King of Heaven comes, he can't stop me! I will definitely kill this little bastard!"
The murderous intention in Chu Xunyi's eyes became more and more intense. If the Buddha stood in the way, he would kill the Buddha, and if the god stood in the way, he would kill the god!
"It's over...How come Fourth Uncle has mastered martial arts at this time...Seventh Brother..."
On the side, Chu Yingying was so anxious that she almost cried.
Just when she was at a loss, a roar came from the door of the yard.
"I, the King of Heaven, can't stop you? What about me?"
After the voice fell, Chu Shan walked in quickly.
In just one or two steps, he appeared in front of Chu Chi.
"Grandpa, great, you're back!"
On the side, Chu Yingying breathed a sigh of relief.
Chu Shan's position in the Chu family was absolutely no one dared to disobey.
Sure enough, Chu Xunyi's fist gradually dropped.
Chu Shan's expression softened a little, and he asked in a cold voice: "Tell me, why are you causing trouble for Chu Chi? Did I specifically explain before I left that the grudge between Chu Chi and Chu Nan ends here."
Chu Xunyi pointed at Chu Nan's body and said with a trembling voice: "Dad, Chu Nan is dead! He couldn't bear Chu Chi's humiliation and hung himself away!"
Chu Shan's pupils shrank, and then he saw Chu Nan's body next to the flower bed.
His body was stiff and he had lost his breath.
This kid committed suicide?
Grass egg, what a piece of trash!
This little blow will kill you.
"Dad, you know my character. I am just such a son! Chu Chi killed him, and I want him to pay for it with his life! Dad, you can protect him for a moment, but can you keep him guarded for twelve hours? No matter what, I want this little bastard to die!"
Hearing this, Chu Shan said nothing.
If Chu Xunyi was determined to kill Chu Chi, it would be impossible for him to protect Chu Chi 24 hours a day.
Just when he didn't know what to say, Chu ChiSuddenly he spoke.
"Chu Xunyi, you've had enough. Does Chu Nan's death have anything to do with me? I didn't kill him. It was because he had a fragile mind and couldn't bear the blow. This is the result of being pampered since childhood!
Didn't he always call me a waste, but I think he is the waste. At this age, he is just a flower in a greenhouse, unable to withstand any wind or rain. He deserves to die! "
Chu Chi's words shocked everyone.
No one thought that at this time, he would dare to confront Chu Xunyi.
At this moment, Chu Xunyi’s head was almost smoking!
"Whoa, whoa, whoa, little bastard, if I don't kill you, I won't be Chu Xunyi!"
Chu Chi said without changing his expression: "I know you want to kill me, but if you kill me like this, people will laugh. Let's do this, I will give you an honest opportunity, and I will challenge you to a fight! Ten days later, I will have a life-and-death battle with you in the main courtyard. Do you dare to accept the challenge?"
When Chu Chi said these words, the whole audience was shocked.
Whether it was Chu Shan, Chu Yingying, or Chu Xunyi himself, they all looked confused and couldn't believe their ears.
Chu Chi actually took the initiative to make a fight with Chu Xunyi!
A junior actually asked an elder to fight.
Moreover, it is still a life and death battle.
Oh my God, this is crazy!
If Chu Chi can defeat Chu Xunyi, then cockroaches will dominate the world!
"What are you talking about? You want to fight with me? But don't do this! I'm afraid you want to take advantage of this time to escape from Feiyun Village!"
Chu Xunyi said coldly, not believing that Chu Chi would really fight him.
This little bastard will definitely take advantage of this time difference and fly away.
"Escape? Who do you look down on?"
Chu Chi stretched out his hand and pointed to the main courtyard.
On the roof of the main courtyard, there is a clan flag embroidered with the word "Chu".
"I swear by the law of heaven in front of the clan flag that if I run away, I will be struck by thunder and die."
"Chu Xunyi, let me ask you, do you dare to fight? Are you afraid that you will lose to me in ten days and be laughed out of your tribe?"
"I will lose to you, what are you talking about in your sleep! Okay, I'll give you another ten days to survive, and cherish this last time."
"So, you agreed?"
"Yes, I agreed. If you seek death on your own, of course I will help you."
After Chu Xunyi finished speaking, he suppressed the murderous intention in his heart, picked up Chu Nan's body, and left step by step.
After Chu Xunyi left, Chu Shan looked at Chu Chi and said, "Thank you for coming up with such a way. Let's leave quickly before the fourth child reacts."
Chu Chi frowned and asked: "Grandpa, do you think that what I just said and the oath I swore is just a temporary measure, and you also think that I want to run away?"
"What else? You are only at the third level of the mortal realm. Let alone ten days, even if I give you ten months, or even ten years, you may not be the opponent of the fourth child!"
After saying this, Chu Yingying agreed very much. She said with a worried look on her face: "Brother Qi, it's better to run away! Don't worry about the oath. Breaking the oath is better than losing your life. Living is the most important thing. Let's go."
But Chu Chi shook his head and said with firm eyes: "You guys look down on me too much. I won't leave. In ten days, I will trample Chu Xunyi under my feet in front of you."
Chu Yingying looked shocked: "Brother Seven, are you serious? But I have never heard of a junior being a rival to an elder."
Chu Chi said in a sonorous voice: "Ten days later, you will have heard it."
After saying these words, Chu Shan's eyes narrowed. This boy seemed to be extremely confident in himself.
